description: Use when you need sentiment analysis, text sentiment or opinion mining of reviews, comments or headlines in English. Do not use for neutral or emotion labels, non-English text or aspect-level sentiment. Returns JSON with sentiment analysis of English text: a positive or negative label with a confidence score, from DistilBERT SST-2 on Workers AI, for one text or a batch of up to 20 for 0.004 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Inference. Price: US$0.004 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

text.description: One English text to classify, e.g. The checkout was fast (up to 2000 characters)

texts.description: Or a batch of up to 20 English texts, e.g. ["Great support", "Broken on arrival"]

name: blackwood_text_sentiment
title: Sentiment analysis
